speaker: Penny
text: Yeah, well, your ken can kiss my Barbie. Sheldon! Sheldon! Sheldon!

text: Woman, you are playing with forces beyond your ken. Yes?

speaker: Penny
text: Where are my clothes? Yes, I left them in the washer, and when I went down to get them, they were gone.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Despite the sign that says do not leave laundry unattended?

text: You know, I do recall seeing some female undergarments. Where was that? Oh, yes. Earlier this evening, I happened to gaze out the window, and a brassiere caught my eye.

speaker: Penny
text: How the hell did you get them up on that telephone wire?

text: When you understand the laws of physics, Penny, anything is possible. And may I add, moi, mon, mon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Apologize? Well, then may I suggest you get a very long stick and play panty piñata?

speaker: Penny
text: Wait, Sheldon, this has gotten way out of hand, okay? I've done some stupid things, you've done some stupid things, how about we just call it even and move on with our lives?

text: How come you've gotten me knee halfway here?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I am kneeing you halfway. I'm willing to concede that you've done some stupid things. Hey, you guys are talking again. Good. What happened?

speaker: Penny
text: Leonard, remember when I said it was on? Well, now it's Junior Rodeo on.

text: Oh, not Junior Rodeo. What did you do? I had no choice, Leonard. She ruined laundry night.
